title: Thread-safe LRU cache
prompt:
Implement a string cache that's safe for concurrent use and holds at most `capacity` entries:

- `NewLRU(capacity int) *LRU`
- `Get(k string) (string, bool)`
- `Set(k, v string)`

When full, `Set` of a new key evicts the least recently used entry. Both `Get` and `Set` count as a use.

Capacity 2: `Set a`, `Set b`, `Get a`, `Set c` → `b` is evicted.
hint: A map to `*list.Element` plus `container/list`, moved to the front on each use, all under one `sync.Mutex` (Get mutates, so no RWMutex).
